title.en: An Act Declaring October 5 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Sta. Cruz, Province of Davao Del Sur, to Be Known as "Araw Ng Sta. Cruz', in Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary
title.orig: An Act Declaring October 5 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Sta. Cruz, Province of Davao Del Sur, to Be Known as "Araw Ng Sta. Cruz', in Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 5 tháng 10 hằng năm là ngày làm việc lễ đặc biệt tại Đô thị Sta. Cruz, Tỉnh Davao Del Sur với tên gọi "Araw Ng Sta. Cruz', nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 5 ตุลาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันทำงานพิเศษในเทศบาล Sta. Cruz จังหวัด Davao Del Sur ในชื่อ "Araw Ng Sta. Cruz' เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 5 Oktober setiap tahun sebagai hari kerja khusus di Kotamadya Sta. Cruz, Provinsi Davao Del Sur dengan nama "Araw Ng Sta. Cruz', dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 5 Oktober setiap tahun sebagai hari bekerja khas di Perbandaran Sta. Cruz, Wilayah Davao Del Sur dengan nama "Araw Ng Sta. Cruz', sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

text.en: October 5 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the Municipality of Sta. Cruz, Province of Davao del Sur, to be known as "Araw ng Sta. Cruz", in commemoration of its foundation anniversary. However, upon proclamation of the President, October 5 of every year shall be a special non-working holiday in the Municipality of Sta. Cruz, Province of Davao del Sur.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
